snippet.title: Dead as Disco - Early Access Release Date Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about Dead as Disco: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3404260 

Martial arts meets music video in Dead as Disco, a neon-drenched Beat ‘Em Up where every punch, kick, and combo syncs to the music. Play as Charlie Disco, a fallen icon with one chance to reclaim the spotlight from the Idols – Charlie’s ex-bandmates and musical legends. Confront the Idols in stylish combat that syncs to every song, and survive a world torn apart by music, fame, and betrayal. Dead as Disco's music transcends boundaries! Rock out to our streamer safe original soundtrack or beat down to licensed bangers past and present. Not enough? Then bring your own killer tracks to the party with My Music! Convert any song in your music library into new game content quickly and easily. Coming to Early Access on May 5th 2026!

Follow news and updates on The Triple-i Initiative:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/triple-i-initiative-2026 
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/iii-initiative.bsky.social 
Bilibili: https://space.bilibili.com/3546638813497663 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/iii_initiative/
Twitter: https://x.com/iii_initiative 

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!

You can learn more over on https://iii-initiative.com
